messages:
rachel_cs: FYI ticket ACME-2319 — customer reports their ingest pipeline started failing after last canary. They claim previously-valid JSON is now sometimes prefixed with arbitrary text, breaking their strict parser. Sample from customer (copied from logs):
```
Expected: {
  "order_id": 9876,
  "items": [{"sku": "X1", "qty": 2}]
}
Actual (examples):
INFO: processing-step=normalize
{
  "order_id": 9876,
  "items": [{"sku": "X1", "qty": 2}]
}
---
RESPONSE:
{
  "order_id": 9876,
  "items": null
}
```
They say this started immediately after the canary flip earlier today. Customer is blocked (parser is strict) and needs a short-term workaround + ETA on fix. Attaching customer's repro: curl call they used.

rachel_cs: curl they used:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <KEY>' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"rdx-lite-v2","prompt":"Produce order JSON only","stream":false,"structured_output":true}'
```

matt_eng: @rachel_cs can you paste the `model` / `model_version` and the rollout id from the customer's headers/response? also any sample request ids from their logs so we can grep server logs.

rachel_cs: model=rdx-lite-v2, model_version=2026-06-01, rollout_id=r-2026-06-canary-14, customer provided request ids: rq_0a1b2c3d, rq_4e5f6g7h. They said both examples above came from rq_0a1b2c3d.

preeti_ml: quick thought — we shipped a small change to the structured-output envelope handling for that model line this morning (adds a preface block for provenance in some cases). it should only be enabled for experimental customers, but maybe the canary flag flipped it on accidentally. can someone check the rollout config for `structured_output_envelope`?

matt_eng: reproducing locally now using their payload + model_version pinned. i can confirm: when `structured_output`=true i sometimes get a one-line prefix `INFO: source=filter` before the JSON. when streaming is enabled the prefix comes as its own event; when stream=false it appears inline.

matt_eng: example from our server logs for rq_0a1b2c3d:
```
[2026-06-01T15:02:11Z] rq_0a1b2c3d model=rdx-lite-v2 v=2026-06-01 rollout=r-2026-06-canary-14 output_preface=INFO: source=filter
{"order_id":9876,"items":[{"sku":"X1","qty":2}]}
```
deploy-bot: Deploy finished: rollout r-2026-06-canary-14 -> 20% traffic. Link: https://deploys.redwood.ai/r-2026-06-canary-14

preeti_ml: that deploy note matches. looks like a config flag accidentally enabled envelope preface for the canary slice. probable root cause: feature gate default changed in the runtime config for rdx-lite models (commit 6a3b9f).

matt_eng: short-term workaround for the customer: set `structured_output=false` OR add a small pre-parse step to strip leading lines until you see a `{` or `[` as the first non-whitespace char. both are workable; structured_output=false will remove some extra validation helpers on our side though.

rachel_cs: i've sent the workaround to the customer (strip-preface + fallback to structured_output=false). customer asked for a permanent fix timeline and whether we can auto-detect and strip these prefaces on the API edge before returning to customers.

matt_eng: for permanent fix we should revert the feature gate for canary immediately and roll a patch to ensure envelope preface is behind a customer opt-in flag. i'll open a PR to revert the runtime default and request a hotfix rollback of r-2026-06-canary-14.

preeti_ml: agree. i'll add a unit/integration test to ensure generated responses never include non-JSON prefaces when `structured_output`=true and `envelope_opt_in`=false.

rachel_cs: thanks all. i'll update ACME with ETA (planning rollback within next 2 hours) and mark ticket high priority. will follow up here when rollback is scheduled. :thumbsup:
